verdicts.typography: Strong typographic hierarchy and Swiss-style discipline. Mono uppercase labels are perfectly applied. One minor nitpick: the body text line-height feels slightly tight for long-form reading, and the stat strip numbers could use slightly more breathing room from their container borders.
verdicts.color: Flawless execution of the minimalist palette. Single restrained red accent used consistently for emphasis, status indicators, and interactive elements. Near-black on white provides excellent contrast. No off-brand colors or visual noise detected.
verdicts.layout: Excellent grid alignment and generous whitespace rhythm. Hairline borders are clean and consistent. Minor deduction because the footer is not visible/pushed to the document bottom in the provided viewport (d1-hero shows it floating), and the analysis grid (d4) has an asymmetric red block that slightly breaks the strict modular grid expectation.
verdicts.components: High-quality component design. The matrix table uses clear iconography (solid/dashed/empty squares) and a smart sticky highlighted final column. Accordion affordances are clear. Stat strip is well-proportioned. Slight deduction because the matrix table lacks visible sticky behavior for the first column in the static screenshot, and the 'Issue' toast in the bottom-left feels like a dev artifact rather than a production UI element.
verdicts.responsive: Mobile layout is solid with good stacking and readable type. The matrix table handles horizontal scrolling effectively with a sticky first column, though the 'SWIPE TO COMPARE' hint is partially clipped on the right edge in the initial view. Dark mode execution is excellent with high contrast and a consistent palette across all sections.

typography: Increase body copy line-height from ~1.5 to ~1.625 for improved readability in long paragraphs; add 2-4px bottom padding to stat strip numbers to decouple them visually from the card border.
layout: Ensure the footer is pinned to the viewport bottom using flex/grid layout techniques when content is shorter than the screen height; verify the red 'THE RESULT' block in the analysis grid aligns strictly with the grid columns above it.
components: Remove or hide the 'N 1 Issue' debug toast before production deployment; verify that the first column of the matrix table has `position: sticky; left: 0;` applied for horizontal scrolling.
responsive: Increase right padding or adjust the container width for the 'SWIPE TO COMPARE' text in The Matrix section to prevent it from being clipped at the 390px viewport width.
